<h2>PART I</h2>

<div id="item1">
<h3>Item 1. Business</h3>
<p>Apple Inc. ("Apple") designs, manufactures and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories, and sells a variety of related services.</p>
<p>The Company's fiscal year is the 52- or 53-week period that ends on the last Saturday of September.</p>

<h4>Products</h4>
<p><b>iPhone</b></p>
<p>iPhone is the Company's line of smartphones based on its iOS operating system. During 2023, the Company released iPhone 15, iPhone 15 Plus, iPhone 15 Pro and iPhone 15 Pro Max.</p>

<p><b>Mac</b></p>
<p>Mac is the Company's line of personal computers based on its macOS operating system. During 2023, the Company released new versions of MacBook Pro and Mac mini.</p>

<p><b>iPad</b></p>
<p>iPad is the Company's line of multipurpose tablets based on its iPadOS operating system.</p>

<h4>Services</h4>
<p>The Company offers various services including advertising, AppleCare, cloud services, digital content and payment services.</p>
</div>

<div id="item1a">
<h3>Item 1A. Risk Factors</h3>
<p>The Company's business, reputation, results of operations, financial condition and stock price can be affected by a number of factors.</p>

<h4>Macroeconomic and Industry Risks</h4>
<p>The Company's operations and performance depend significantly on global and regional economic conditions and adverse economic conditions can materially adversely affect the Company's business.</p>

<p>Global markets for the Company's products and services are highly competitive and subject to rapid technological change, and the Company may be unable to compete effectively in these markets.</p>

<h4>Business and Operational Risks</h4>
<p>To remain competitive and stimulate customer demand, the Company must successfully manage frequent introductions and transitions of products and services.</p>

<p>The Company depends on the performance of distributors, carriers and other resellers.</p>

<p>The Company depends on component and product manufacturing and logistical services provided by outsourcing partners.</p>
</div>

<div id="item7">
<h3>Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations</h3>
<p>The following discussion should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and accompanying notes.</p>

<h4>Fiscal 2023 Highlights</h4>
<p>Total net sales were $383.3 billion during 2023, a decrease of 3% compared to 2022.</p>

<table>
<tr><th>Category</th><th>2023</th><th>2022</th><th>Change</th></tr>
<tr><td>iPhone</td><td>$200.6B</td><td>$205.5B</td><td>(2%)</td></tr>
<tr><td>Mac</td><td>$29.4B</td><td>$40.2B</td><td>(27%)</td></tr>
<tr><td>iPad</td><td>$28.3B</td><td>$29.3B</td><td>(3%)</td></tr>
<tr><td>Services</td><td>$85.2B</td><td>$78.1B</td><td>9%</td></tr>
</table>

<h4>Liquidity and Capital Resources</h4>
<p>The Company believes its existing balances of cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities will be sufficient to satisfy its working capital needs.</p>
</div>
